issues.issue: Did the respondent obtain refugee status by directly or indirectly misrepresenting material facts (fake FIR and warrant)?
issues.applicant_position: Respondent filed a fraudulent FIR and arrest warrant and misrepresented being wanted in Pakistan.
issues.respondent_position: FIR and warrant are genuine; his Pakistani lawyer confirmed the case against him.
issues.result_quote: I conclude that the principal respondent made false representations on material facts in his original claim for refugee status

issues.issue: Is the altered national identity card a further material misrepresentation?
issues.applicant_position: National identity card was altered, so the identity documents were false.
issues.respondent_position: Identity documents were not properly photocopied, causing confusion in verification.
issues.result_quote: I will not pursue my analysis on the issue of material misrepresentations on the identity

issues.issue: Is there other sufficient evidence to justify refugee protection (s.109(2))?
issues.applicant_position: No other sufficient evidence remains once the false documents are set aside.
issues.result_quote: I also conclude that there remains no other sufficient evidence that was considered at the time of the first determination to justify refugee protection
